COLUMNS_JOIN_BY_POSITION: `l`, `n`, `b` and `to` are parallel and the same length. `kinds` gives each kind's [start, end) run over them. `ay0`/`ay1` are dense over the `addr` run only. `sub` is a sparse map of place addresses; `sum` is a list of positions.

WHAT_A_KIND_MEANS.hood: a division of the map. Exact.
WHAT_A_KIND_MEANS.street: a street with a record file of its own. Exact.
WHAT_A_KIND_MEANS.place: a curated civic place. The only kind that carries money.
WHAT_A_KIND_MEANS.addr: a door the Board of Supervisors printed a house number for. NOT a register of San Francisco's addresses — an address absent from this list is an address the record never named.

REP_IS_A_REPRESENTATIVE: `rep` marks an entry whose block is the one holding the most of its records, not the whole of it. A street and a division have no single block; the map has to be sent somewhere, and this is where.
